raw:
Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The agent failed to correctly extract and report the birthplace information from the Wikipedia page it visited. Although the Wikipedia infobox clearly stated "Born: Benito Perojo Gonz lez, June 14, 1894, Madrid, Spain," the agent's analysis incorrectly claimed that the Wikipedia page contained conflicting information (citing the body text about Buenos Aires) and deemed it unreliable without further verification. This led to an unnecessary loop of searching for other sources (Britannica, BFI) to confirm what was already clearly stated in the infobox of the very page the agent had just accessed. The agent misinterpreted the presence of a discrepancy in the article body (which was likely an error in the Wikipedia article itself, as the infobox and other sources like IMDb and Find a Grave consistently said Madrid) as a reason to distrust the primary source (the infobox) rather than recognizing the infobox as the authoritative summary on that page.
